recognize_zh: 上方單核球與下方嗜中性球胞質內都有數個金黃褐色、細小棒狀的折光性結晶，而左下另一顆白血球沒有；背景紅血球呈鋸齒狀，符合高膽紅素血症時白血球內的膽紅素結晶。
features: Monocyte (top) with irregular nucleus and gray-blue cytoplasm containing several small golden-yellow rod-shaped crystals
Neutrophil (bottom) with lobulated nucleus and similar golden crystals over nucleus and cytoplasm
A band/segmented leukocyte at lower left without visible crystals
Background crenated red cells; a degenerated brownish cell remnant in the center
Image is low resolution and slightly blurred
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows crenated red cells and three leukocytes. A monocyte and a neutrophil each contain several small, golden-yellow, refractile, rod-shaped intracytoplasmic crystals, while a third leukocyte lacks them; a degenerated brownish cell remnant is also present. The low image resolution limits detailed crystal morphology. Findings are consistent with bilirubin crystals within neutrophils and monocytes, associated with marked hyperbilirubinemia.

ddx.vs: Hemosiderin is granular golden-brown to blue-black and Prussian blue-positive, whereas bilirubin crystals are yellow rods that are iron-negative.
Hemozoin is brown-black granular pigment with parasitized red cells, which are not seen here.
Stain precipitate is purple-black and deposits randomly over cells and background, not as yellow intracytoplasmic rods.
